entries.speaker: Kamoshida
entries.en: Things have been pretty dangerous lately[n]with all those accidents.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Sorry, I have a photoshoot today. It's for[n]the special summer issue, so I can't afford[n]to miss it...

entries.speaker: Kamoshida
entries.en: Hey, now... Being a model's fine and[n]dandy, but don't work your pretty little[n]self to the bone.

entries.speaker: Kamoshida
entries.en: You mentioned you weren't feeling well,[n]right? Something about appendicitis?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Yes. I keep planning to go to the hospital,[n]but I've been too busy... Sorry to worry[n]you.

entries.speaker: Kamoshida
entries.en: You must be lonely too. I feel bad for[n]keeping your best friend at practice[n]so often.

entries.speaker: Kamoshida
entries.en: Oh, and... be careful around that[n]transfer student.

entries.speaker: Kamoshida
entries.en: He's got a criminal record, after all.[n]If something were to happen to you...
